title: Affine evaluation of the sheaf coproduct of truncated higher images
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $I$ a set, and $E_i\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. For integers $a,q$, put $M_i=H^q(Rf_*\tau_{\ge a}E_i)$, with $Rf_*$ as in [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For every affine open $U\subset Y$, evaluation at $U$ sends the canonical coproduct cocone $M_i\to\bigoplus_i M_i$ in module sheaves to a colimit cocone of $\mathcal O_Y(U)$-modules. No ambient derived coproduct S is involved.

source.place: Bounded-below quasi-coherence paragraph with Tag 015J, followed by affine quasi-coherent colimit evaluation, Tag 01I7.

proof.text: Canonical lower truncation preserves quasi-coherent cohomology and has lower bound a: below a the homology is zero, above a it is unchanged. Use the free sheaf on the empty type to see that zero is quasi-coherent.

Apply bounded-below hypercohomology to each lower truncation. The second pages are ordinary higher images of quasi-coherent homology. Over an affine target open the preimage is qcqs. Localization of its cohomology, obtained from affine acyclicity and Mayer--Vietoris induction, commutes with principal restrictions. The higher-image presheaf description then gives the affine localization criterion for quasi-coherence of the second-page sheaves.

Every later page is a kernel modulo an image. Kernel and cokernel/image closure propagate quasi-coherence. In total degree q the finite convergent filtration has stable page terms as graded pieces. Descending induction from its zero step using extension closure proves that every M_i is quasi-coherent; below a it is zero.

The sheaf coproduct of these quasi-coherent M_i is quasi-coherent. Apply affine evaluation of quasi-coherent colimit cocones to this canonical coproduct cocone. This includes the empty family and the empty open.

proof_origin.place: V1 extracts quasi-coherence plus affine coproduct evaluation as an independent part of the finite-support argument. Localization proof is the same local argument recorded in the original item.

theorem truncated_higherImages_affine_coproduct
    {X Y : Scheme.{u₁}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w₂} (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : Type u₁) (E : I → schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (a q : ℤ) (U : Y.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace) (op U)).mapCocone
        (Cofan.mk
          (∐ (fun i ↦ (schemeHigherDirectImage f q).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE a).obj (E i).obj)))
          (Sigma.ι (fun i ↦ (schemeHigherDirectImage f q).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE a).obj (E i).obj))))))
